title: Review framework per-project config
description: Targets the generic review plugin to a specific repo. Place at .claude/review.config.json. Anything omitted falls back to DEFAULT_CONFIG in the published bladeforge-review-harness package.

persona.description: Voice/flavor toggle for reviewer agents that support it, notably the craft lens. 'twitch' = themed Twitch plague-rat voice; 'plain' = neutral prose. Substance (verdict/findings) is identical either way.

base.description: Git base ref for the cumulative diff. Defaults to the branch upstream, else origin/main.

secretAllowlist.description: Extra markers (matched against the secret VALUE) that suppress secret-scan false positives.

name.description: Reviewer id. The 5 built-ins are craft, architecture, tests, docs, security; others are appended.

skills.description: Skill ids the agent loads (encode the project's rules).

extensionSkill.description: Optional prose skill for rules too complex for config fields (the escape hatch).

checks.description: Deterministic commands /review runs ONCE per round (step 2.5), whose results are handed to this lens as machine-verified facts. The deterministic half of the lens's subject — a paired-doc gate, a typecheck — so the lens spends judgment calls only on what a command cannot decide. A failing check is evidence for the lens to weigh, never a gate by itself.

name.description: Short label the lens cites, e.g. docs-check

command.description: The exact shell command, run from the repo root

pattern.description: Regex grepped across the whole changed set.

code.description: Glob; when a changed path matches it, the doc must also change.
